fact: TAMISEMI's ICT director said in March 2023 that the new TAUSI system, replacing LGRCIS, lets taxpayers pay licences and levies through a self-service portal and lets the government see how many POS devices every council has, who uses them and what they collected.
title: Fahamu Kuhusu Tausi, Mfumo Mpya wa Ukusanyaji Mapato Serikalini
